jobs.title: Group Finance Director
jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our investment platform and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with commercial judgement and execution excellence.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As we expand our portfolio of AI factories, GPU clusters, and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring a Group Finance Director to lead across financial reporting, financial planning, strategic finance and finance operations.

This is a highly visible role working directly with the executive team and shareholders that will interact with all parts of the business from procurement to operations. You will lead the finance function on a day-to day basis and build scalable processes to support business growth.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Leadership and development of group finance functions, overseeing all aspects across; FP&A, Controllership, Treasury and Finance Operations

 - Provide support for the process around acquisitions and strategic partnerships

 - Build meaningful relationships with customers and suppliers ensuring best in class working capital management, overseeing AR, AP, payroll

 - Manage debt compliance in project finance and SPV environment, managing complex organisation structure.

 - Manage customer and supplier onboarding as well as shareholder requests

 - Develop and review the annual budget, forecast and scenario planning process and facilitate monthly business reviews, ensuring the constant measurement of business performance against target.

 - Implement strategies to enhance profit margins through effective pricing, cost control, and operational efficiencies. Own monitoring of key customer and supplier contracts and collaborate across functions to identify opportunities for margin improvement and ensure alignment with overall business objectives.

 - Document and improve current finance processes, identifying manual workarounds, control gaps and opportunities for automation.

 - Lead or support finance system improvements, reporting enhancements and implementation projects, with external support where required.

 - Partner with Sales and Marketing to assess ROI, funnel conversion across customer segments.

 - Lead scenario modelling and commercial forecasting to support data-led decision-making.

 - Oversee group financial reporting to ensure delivery of timely consolidated management accounts, statutory reporting and performance of regular audits.

 - Interface directly with Senior Leadership Team and shareholders.

 - Drive continuous improvement and utilise AI to drive a world class financial reporting and control function.

 - Develop and track key commercial KPIs and dashboards to drive accountability and performance.

 - Prepare board packs and present key insights to PE investors.

 - Lead treasury operations, liquidity management, and cash forecasting.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Qualified accountant with previous experience as a group finance director in a PE backed business, managing broad range of activities across a finance function.

 - Demonstrated experience in leading build out of scalable finance operations.

 - Experience working in multi-jurisdictional operating landscapes including establishing presence in new jurisdictions.

 - Strong working VAT compliance and tax compliance knowledge with experience of preparing / reviewing and filing VAT and annual tax returns.

 - Experience managing transfer pricing assessments and compliance.

 - Strong treasury, liquidity management, and risk management expertise.

 - Strong conceptual and financial skills and ability to envision the “big picture”, while being “hands-on” and maintaining close attention to detail.

 - Team-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to shared success above any personal accomplishment or recognition

 - Ability to operate independently in ambiguous and fast-moving environments.

 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

 - High levels of ownership, accountability and attention to detail.

 - Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for the AI infrastructure ecosystem, analytical skills and creative problem-solving ability.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in data centres, digital infrastructure, telecommunications, energy, power, utilities or cloud infrastructure.

 - Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, AI infrastructure, hyperscaler ecosystems or energy markets.

 - Exposure to power markets and commodity hedging.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Build a best in class finance function, balancing historic reporting with forward-looking insights

 - Full financial compliance across global operations with agility to expand into new regions.

 - Establish scalable treasury and risk management frameworks.

 - Become a trusted advisor to the executive team.


WHY JOIN RADIANT

 - Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry

 - Build infrastructure that underpins the next industrial revolution.

 - Help shape a category-defining company at the intersection of power, compute and capital.

 - Participate in the company's growth and value creation.

 - Collaborate with experienced operators, investors and technologists.

jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Title:  People Operations

Reports to: People Manager

Location: London hybrid



About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure, from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one, who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.



About the role

We are hiring a People Operations Specialist to run the employee lifecycle at Radiant and to keep making it better as we grow.

We're looking for someone who loves building automations, agents and workflows, and wants to point that instinct at People Ops. You'll own the data and systems behind our People Ops stack (HiBob, Ashby, Notion), and use that ownership as the foundation for turning slow, manual, multi-tool processes into things that mostly run themselves. This is a role for someone who'd rather ship a working automation this week and improve it next week than spend a month planning the perfect system - someone who gets a genuine kick out of making the unglamorous stuff disappear. You’ll bring expertise, energy, and commercial thinking to help us elevate our People processes. The challenge in this role is to put the systems and frameworks in place that let us scale that quality, consistency, and fairness as we grow – without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.



What you'll do


PEOPLE OPERATIONS (~80%)

 - Run new joiner onboarding end to end, but treat every manual step you touch twice as a candidate for automation, with the goal is to keep making the process faster and lighter-touch, not just execute it reliably.

 - Administer employee lifecycle changes (promotions, transfers, terminations) across systems, and build the guardrails - validation rules, alerts, review steps etc.

 - Process documentation: create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and playbooks for onboarding, offboarding, and systems admin current as processes evolve, so nothing lives only in your head.

 - Own and execute core HR operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes and off-boarding.

 - Ensure compliance with local labour laws and internal policies across different regions.

 - Coordinate team socials, offsites, and the other moments that bring a distributed team together.

 - Liaise with our payroll providers (UK and US) to process any changes, corrections, or new starters/leavers each cycle

 - Keep policies and the employee handbook up to date and ensure compliance with any UK/US regulatory changes during the cover period

 - Translate employee feedback into concrete action points and employee journey initiatives

 - Employee first-line support: be the first point of contact for day-to-day employee questions on payroll, leave, benefits, and admin

 - Administer employee lifecycle changes (promotions, transfers, terminations) across systems, and build the guardrails - validation rules, alerts, review steps etc, that catch data errors before they become a downstream mess in payroll or compliance.


IMPROVING IT (~20%)

 - Support and contribute to improving, automating, and streamlining HR processes, with a focus on scalability and efficiency.

 - Design, build, and maintain automations, workflows, and AI agents across our People Ops tooling (HiBob, Ashby, Notion) - from a simple triggered workflow to a more sophisticated internal agent - turning multi-step manual processes into things that run themselves.

 - Contribute to and take ownership of parts of people-related projects and process improvements.

 - Turn employee feedback into specific, sequenced actions with owners and dates — not a list of themes.

 - Use data from our people systems to show where time is going, what is working, and what to fix next.

 - Keep the People pages in Notion current, and improve them as you learn where colleagues get stuck.

 - Partner with relevant stakeholders on anything touching UK employment or compliance judgement calls while you build fluency here. You own the system and the escalation path, and that ownership shifts to you over time.



What you'll bring

 - You've worked in a high-growth environment, ideally remote and across multiple geographies, and you're comfortable working async across EMEA time zones.

 - Experience building people systems in scaling companies, ideally through comparable periods of fast growth.

 - A practical, hands-on approach – comfortable building from scratch rather than inheriting an established function.

 - Strong judgement and a commercial mindset.

 - The ability to influence managers and senior leaders through credibility rather than authority.

 - Comfort with ambiguity, pace, and a deliberately low-process environment.

jobs.title: Principal Procurement Lead, Compute and Storage
jobs.description:
About Radiant

As part of the Infrastructure team, we are seeking a highly strategic, technically fluent, and commercially astute Principal Procurement Lead, Compute and Storage. In this role, you will own the end-to-end procurement strategy, engage with vendor ecosystems, and contribute to commercial negotiations for our highest-value capital investments. This includes high-density GPU clusters, high-performance network fabrics, storage, and our upcoming site connectivity.

You will serve as the primary bridge between our internal Infrastructure teams and the world's leading technology OEMs (e.g. Nvidia, HPE, Dell, Lenovo, Supermicro…) and storage vendors (Weka, Vast, DDN…). Your mission is to build the most effective and resilient supply chain to support the implementation of our Technology roadmap, optimize our clusters’ Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and mitigate global supply chain risks for massive, cutting-edge computing infrastructure deployments.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are expanding our footprint of AI factories and GPU clusters. This role runs procurement for the compute and storage category, globally. That covers GPU systems, servers, racks, networking within the rack, and storage platforms.

You own the path from technical design to signed commercial package. You deal directly with the leading compute and storage OEMs, and internally with Architecture, Technical Operations, Commercial and Finance. Individual packages run from a few million dollars to nine figures.

Our procurement model splits by category area, and further leads will follow as we scale. This is the first of those roles. You set the standards the rest inherit.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own category strategy for compute and storage, refreshed each quarter against the technology roadmap.

 - Structure, issue and score RFIs and RFPs. Requirement capture through to purchase order.

 - Own the price book for every vendor in your category. Line-item level, version controlled, and the source Finance uses for CapEx forecasts.

 - Validate every bill of materials before a purchase order goes out. You run that review across Architecture, Technical Operations, Commercial and Finance.

 - Negotiate commercial terms. Volume discounts, maintenance, software bundling, freight, delivery windows.

 - Normalise competing bids into one comparable CapEx position per configuration, and hand that to Finance for TCO and unit economics.

 - Run quarterly supplier scorecards and hold the escalation path into each vendor account team.

 - Publish a monthly lead time and allocation view for Infrastructure and DC Development. You flag slippage before it reaches a build schedule.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 7+ years in strategic sourcing, category management or technical supply chain. At least three years on IT infrastructure hardware.

 - Direct negotiation with hardware OEMs on capital purchases above $10m.

 - You can read a server bill of materials and challenge it. Wrong part numbers, missing optics and cables, undersized drives, support lines that do not match the service terms.

 - You build the CapEx and vendor cost models Finance relies on. Every line traceable to a quote, and you defend the inputs in review.

 - You hold a position against a vendor account team under time pressure.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in HPC, AI infrastructure, hyperscale datacentres or cloud infrastructure.

 - CIPS or CPSM.

 - Sourcing under allocation constraint. GPUs, HBM, optics.


WHY JOIN RADIANT

 - Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry.

 - Build infrastructure that underpins the next industrial revolution.

 - Help shape a category-defining company at the intersection of power, compute and capital.

 - Participate in the company's growth and value creation.

 - Collaborate with experienced operators, investors and technologists.

jobs.title: GRC Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we're building out our governance, risk and compliance capability with people who enjoy creating structure from scratch and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

We're building out a dedicated Governance, Risk & Compliance function — moving from a mix of individual ownership and external consultancy support to a resourced team that scales with the business. As GRC Analyst, you'll project manage our compliance programme end-to-end, working alongside a Principal Security Engineer who owns the technical security posture.

This is a builder's role. You won't be inheriting a mature, fully-documented programme — you'll be creating and automating the processes, evidence trails and tracking that don't fully exist yet. You'll have senior guidance close at hand, both internally and through Brookfield's governance frameworks, but you're the one who makes the programme run day to day.

As Radiant's obligations grow — spanning business continuity, AI governance, and an expanding footprint into owned and operated data centre and powered-land infrastructure — this role will grow with them.




WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 - Own end-to-end project management of the compliance programme: support ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, manage the policy lifecycle, and handle customer security questionnaires and KYC onboarding

 - Manage data protection operations and training, with UK GDPR at the core

 - Build and continuously improve how we work — automate manual, currently ad hoc processes (evidence collection, policy tracking, questionnaire responses) rather than running them from scratch each time

 - Coordinate business continuity: BCP/DR obligations and ownership of the Major Incident process, including testing and evidencing

 - Support our AI governance work — our internal AI and engineering AI policies — and help us keep pace with a fast-moving regulatory backdrop (including the EU AI Act), covering data handling, human oversight and vendor assessment

 - Coordinate health & safety compliance as we expand into physical premises and data centre operations, helping build a proper H&S management system where none currently exists

 - Partner closely with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, particularly on KYC, Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC) evidence, and technical control documentation

 - Help benchmark and align our Code of Conduct and policies with Brookfield's

 - Contribute to the wider roadmap as our footprint grows: precious and conflict-minerals due diligence, export controls, and ESG/energy governance


WHAT YOU'LL BRING 

 - Solid UK GDPR and data protection experience

 - Genuine curiosity about how controls actually work — you're not satisfied when "the box is ticked," you want to understand the journey behind it

 - Hyper-organised — you can run multiple concurrent workstreams (audits, questionnaires, training, policy updates) without anything slipping

 - A builder's mindset — comfortable creating and automating a process from nothing, not just following an existing playbook

 - Autonomous and idea-driven — you'll be directed on priorities, not micromanaged on approach

 - Mid-level compliance/GRC/information security experience — your background does not need to be from AI infrastructure, data centres, or a related industry

 - Confident stakeholder management — you'll work directly with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, not just within a compliance team


NICE TO HAVE 

 - Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit cycles

 - Exposure to business continuity or major incident processes

 - Familiarity with AI governance or emerging AI regulation

 - Interest in health & safety, environmental/ESG reporting, or physical security and facilities governance

 - Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or equivalent)
   
   


WHY JOIN RADIANT?

 - Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

 - Real ownership of a function you're building from the ground up, with senior support rather than senior oversight

 - Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry, at the intersection of power, compute and capital

 - Backed by Brookfield — genuine resources, mentorship, and room to grow the role as the company scales
